name: Ubiquiti UniFi Site Manager
description: Official cloud Site Manager API inventory and device connectivity. Location is retained only when explicitly provided by UniFi. Supports native manual branch mapping when location data is missing or disabled.

configFields.label: UniFi Site Manager API key
